'''Sasori Vader''' was a [[Changeling/Legends|changeling]] entity who lived in a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its true form was that of a giant [[Scorpion/Legends|scorpion]] with red glowing eyes, but it could turn into the shape of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Sasori Vader, having somehow managed to take over a Jawa sandcrawler, imprisoned two Jawas (who had also managed to kidnap [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] earlier) and incarcerate them in the bridge area of what used to be their sandcrawler. The young [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] then made his way to the sandcrawler in order to free his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] friend and confront Sasori Vader, who had taken the shape of Darth Vader. During the ensuing fight, Sasori Vader turned back into its true form, but he was eventually defeated and killed by Skywalker.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Sasori_Vader.png|thumb|left|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] confronts Sasori Vader in a [[Sandcrawler/Legends|Sandcrawler]].]]
Sasori Vader was one of the stage bosses in the Japanese [[Star Wars (1987 video game)|''Star Wars'' 1987 video game]]. The game featured various fake Vaders which all happened to be shapeshifting monsters. The [[canon]]icity of this game and the creatures it features is dubious.

According to both "[[Game On!]]," an article published in [[Star Wars Insider 135|''Star Wars Insider'' 135]], and the game manual, the fake Vaders ([[Clados Vader|Clados]], [[Gyaos Vader|Gyaos]], Sasori and [[Wampa Vader|Wampa]]) were "intended as illusions representing Luke's fears, like the [[Cave of Evil/Legends|Cave of Evil]] scene in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|Empire Strikes Back]]."<ref name="SWI135">{{InsiderCite|135|Game On!}}</ref> However, since those game opponents were able to kidnap Luke Skywalker's allies and hold them prisoner, this article assumes they were real creatures rather than illusions. Additionally, the Vader-shaped figure that Skywalker fought in the Cave of Evil was more than mere illusion, being in fact a protean [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity known as the [[Dark Spirit]].<ref name="toy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Darth Vader (Dagobah)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjdagvader.asp}}</ref>

In the game and the original [[Wikipedia:Japanese language|Japanese language]] game manual, the character is called ''Sasori Beidā'' (サソリベイダー).<ref name="Manual">{{WebCite|url=http://www.videogameden.com/fc/extra/sta.pdf|text=Famicom ''Star Wars'' manual|format=pdf|work=Video Game Den|archivedate=20170105222157}}</ref> While ''Beidā'' is a transliteration of "Vader" in Japanese, ''Sasori'' means "scorpion."<ref name="Sasori">{{WebCite|url=http://www.romajidesu.com/dictionary/meaning-of-sasori.html|text=Meaning of ''sasori'' in Japanese|format=pdf|work=RomajiDesu.com|archivedate=20181130081634}}</ref>
